name: Lost in the wash
description: Socks disappear in the laundry. SockLock socks have a small magnet on the cuff: snap the pair before the wash and it comes out together. First five pairs for $29 after a short quiz.

name: Morning rush
description: Mornings with kids are a race and nobody has time to hunt for a matching sock. SockLock pairs stay snapped together from the dryer to the drawer. Five pairs for $29.

name: The gift
description: A useful gift for the friend who always wears mismatched socks. Magnetic pairs that never get separated in the wash. Five pairs for $29, can be sent as a gift.
